storage.title: Where your data lives
storage.text: Entries are stored in this browser’s IndexedDB and encrypted with a key that never leaves the device. Clearing site data in the browser deletes them — so export from time to time.

export.title: Export
export.lead: Files are built right in the browser and downloaded to this device. Export is always available, on any plan.
export.empty: Nothing to export yet — there are no entries.
export.warning: Export files are not encrypted. Keep them where you keep other personal documents and delete copies you no longer need.

json.title: JSON — full copy
json.text: Every field of every entry. For backups and moving to another device.

csv.title: CSV — spreadsheet
csv.text: For Excel, Google Sheets and your own calculations.

md.title: Markdown — readable archive
md.text: All entries by month with a summary — easy to read and keep in your notes.

import.title: Import
import.lead: Upload an impact log JSON export — say, from another device or a backup. Entries will be encrypted and added to the current ones.
import.invalid: {entries} failed validation and will be skipped.
import.mergeHint: New entries are added. An existing entry is updated only if the file has a newer version. Import never deletes anything.
import.warning: The file you import from is stored on your side unencrypted. Delete it if you no longer need it.

errors.invalid: This doesn’t look like an impact log JSON export. Choose a file downloaded in the “Export” section.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large for an impact log export (over 25 MB).
errors.empty: The file has no valid entries.
errors.failed: Couldn’t save the entries. Please try again.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.text: Erase all entries and encryption keys from this device. You’ll only be able to restore them from a JSON export.
danger.textSynced: Erase all entries and encryption keys from this device. They will download from the server again when you sign in to your account.
danger.account: This browser is connected to sync: the encrypted copy of your entries on the server will remain. To delete the account and server data, go to
danger.accountShort: The encrypted copy on the sync server will remain.
danger.dialogText: This deletes {entries} and this browser’s encryption keys. It can’t be undone.
danger.failed: Couldn’t erase the data. Reload the page and try again.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.lead: These objects couldn’t be decrypted when the vault key changed (when you signed in or created an account) — for example, because of data corruption or a different key. They are kept only on this device, don’t appear in the journal and aren’t synced.
quarantine.keep: We keep them in case the data can be recovered. You can download them as they are — encrypted, as JSON — or delete them.
quarantine.dialogText: {objects} will be deleted from this device. This can’t be undone — if they might be useful, download the file first.
quarantine.deleted: Quarantine cleared: the objects were deleted from this device.
quarantine.failed: Couldn’t delete them. Reload the page and try again.
